leads.title: Missouri Save Adolescents from Experimentation (SAFE) Act
leads.documents: State ban since August 28, 2023 on beginning gender-affirming hormones or puberty blockers for under-18s, with grandfather clause and sunset repeal August 28, 2027
leads.detail: Passed by Missouri Legislature May 2023; cited as Missouri Save Adolescents from Experimentation (SAFE) Act

leads.title: 44th Judicial Circuit Court ruling - Judge Robert Craig Carter, November 25, 2024
leads.documents: Trial court ruling that the youth gender-affirming care ban is constitutional after ACLU of Missouri challenge; preliminary injunction denied August 2024, trial September 2024, appeal announced by Lambda Legal and ACLU of Missouri
leads.detail: 44th Judicial Circuit Court, Judge Robert Craig Carter, November 25, 2024 decision

leads.title: Missouri Attorney General Andrew Bailey emergency orders March-April 2023
leads.documents: Declared youth and adult gender-affirming care experimental; imposed screening for social media addiction, 3-month consent, annual dysphoria assessment; adult version required 3 years dysphoria, 15 psychiatric sessions, autism screening, 15-year tracking; both withdrawn May 16, 2023 after legislature acted
leads.detail: AG Andrew Bailey emergency order March 2023 expanded April 2023, withdrawn May 16, 2023; adult order set to expire February 2024, temporarily blocked by judge

leads.title: SB39 - transgender athlete ban
leads.documents: Law banning transgender athletes in female sports/athletics, signed by Governor May 2023 with sunset repeal August 28, 2027
leads.detail: Bill SB39, passed Missouri Legislature May 2023, signed by Governor of Missouri

leads.title: Mo. Ann. Stat. § 193.215(9)
leads.documents: Birth certificate gender change law requiring court order with certified proof of irreversible surgical change on hospital letterhead; workaround cases 13AR-CV00157 (April 22, 2013) and 13AR-CV00240 (May 20, 2013) invalidated/reversed May 2022
leads.detail: Mo. Ann. Stat. § 193.215(9); cases 13AR-CV00157 and 13AR-CV00240; referrals to Missouri Bureau of Vital Statistics

leads.title: Missouri Department of Revenue Form 5532 gender designation policy
leads.documents: 2016-2024 policy allowing license/ID gender changes via Form 5532 after human rights review, abruptly reversed after unspecified incident to again require surgery documentation or court order
leads.detail: Form 5532, in effect 2016-2024, Missouri Department of Revenue

leads.title: H.B. 2009 - trans inmate care funding ban
leads.documents: 2026 law denying gender-affirming healthcare to trans inmates: No funds shall be expended for any cross-sex hormones, or gender transition surgery undertaken for the purpose of any gender transition
leads.detail: Sponsored by Rep. Dirk Deaton, signed by Gov. Mike Kehoe July 2026, effective July 2

leads.title: Lawson v. Kelly, U.S. District Court for the Western District of Missouri, November 7, 2014
leads.documents: Federal ruling by Judge Ortrie D. Smith ordering Jackson County to issue marriage licenses to same-sex couples; shows marriage equality enforcement machinery in Missouri
leads.detail: Listed in External links as Lawson v. Kelly, U.S. District Court for the Western District of Missouri, November 7, 2014; discussed as filed June 24, 2014, appealed to Eighth Circuit December 5

leads.documents: Institutional human-rights profile of Missouri LGBTQ legal status and equality ranking
